tree_digest_algorithm: For sorted relative POSIX file paths inside each tree: SHA256 of concatenated relative_path + NUL + file_sha256_hex + LF (UTF-8). File content hashed with SHA256; symlinks, .local directories and .env/.env.* are excluded.

authorization_and_execution.independent_dynamic_checks: Narrow inline PHP probes using synthetic fixtures and separate SQLite in-memory databases. No test files or persistent databases were created by the reviewer.

confirmed_findings.issue: COUNT(*) allowed duplicate indexed facts to increase recall rank and crowd out a candidate with more distinct query matches.
confirmed_findings.resolution: Deduplicate index space/target/feature/term rows and native eligible IDs before aggregation and route LIMIT.
confirmed_findings.verification: Original inline synthetic SQLite reproduction rerun after code change; no production index writer or source provider was used.

confirmed_findings.issue: Route LIMIT preceded user hard-condition filtering; a nonqualifying early candidate could consume the budget and omit a genuinely qualifying later candidate.
confirmed_findings.resolution: Apply each original hard token condition as its own correlated EXISTS predicates before route LIMIT. Similarity/contribution require all requested tokens; explicit preference accepts alternatives. Fresh rule evaluation remains required.

unsupported_hard_interval_probe.message: Hard interval recall requires an authorized interval index that is not connected.

confirmed_findings.verification: Same inline SQLite reproduction rerun; separate unsupported interval probe confirms explicit failure instead of false empty success.

additional_static_checks: Authenticated actor, selected Space and selection revision are bound; a request Space cannot replace the server selection.
Native SQL rechecks enabled accounts/Space, formal memberships, bilateral user blocks and Space blocks; relation reads are batched and preserve current direction flags.

Native SELECTs use the master connection with query cache disabled, reject an existing transaction snapshot, suppress SQL logging/profiling while executing and restore prior flags in finally. Database exceptions do not retain expanded SQL chains.

P1 metadata adapter copies only ordinary field directory metadata; source-purpose grants pin 18 reviewed schema-2 sources and reject administrative semantic relabeling. This does not authorize any subject value.
CandidateIndexAccess is mandatory before and after bounded retrieval and must prove a complete current authorized generation. No production default fake or index seeding was added to Module/config.

SQL retrieval explicitly rejects unsupported semantic routing and hard interval recall. It now also rejects differing normalized alias maps for one candidate feature; self-mappings are removed and alias keys/values are normalized before comparing.
